Test fixtures for tests/library.js: a few lead-section articles and the OPDS
catalog from "Climate change by Wikipedia" (wikipedia_en_climate_change_mini_2024-06,
openZIM test suite), as served by kiwix-serve. Article text is from Wikipedia,
licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/);
the articles' authors are listed in each article's history on en.wikipedia.org.
search_sample.xml shows kiwix-serve's search reply format (OpenSearch RSS).
